title: Real lab: forward a port through SSH
instruction: This is a real Alpine Linux box running in your browser, with OpenSSH. A service answers ONLY on 127.0.0.1:8000 (run `curl 127.0.0.1:8000` to see it). sshd is running and `ssh root@127.0.0.1` works passwordless. Your task: open an SSH local port forward so that your local port 9000 reaches that service through SSH, then click Verify. Background the tunnel (-f) so you keep your prompt.

verify.success: Solved! Local port 9000 reached the firewalled service through your SSH tunnel, that's `ssh -L LOCAL:HOST:PORT` in action.
verify.fail: Port 9000 isn't reaching the service yet. Open the forward in the background, then Verify.

hint: ssh -fN -L 9000:127.0.0.1:8000 root@127.0.0.1     (-f = background, -N = no remote command). Check it with: curl 127.0.0.1:9000
